name: PMMSY: Refrigerated vehicles - Gujarat
benefit:
1. The unit cost of a refrigerated vehicle is ₹25,00,000/-. 1. 40% assistance (up to ₹10,00,000/-) is provided for general category beneficiaries. 1. 60% assistance (up to ₹15,00,000/-) is provided for women and SC/ST category beneficiaries.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1.
